messages.text:
Hi Professor Alvarez,

Good to see you in the hallway earlier. Following up on what you mentioned: could we meet for 30 minutes this Wednesday at 10:00am? You said the faculty senate meeting that hour is cancelled this week, so I understand you're free then even though your calendar may still show it.

If 10:00 works, I'll consider it set — could you add it to your calendar on your end? Happy to shift if something else comes up.

Thanks,
Diego

Hello — Professor Alvarez here. Could you confirm the official schedule for next week, in particular whether the Faculty Senate meeting on Wednesday 10:00-11:00 is cancelled or still running? A student is asking me for that slot. Thank you.
Hi Diego — thanks for the note. Let me check the department's official schedule for Wednesday and get right back to you.

Good morning, Professor Alvarez.

**Faculty Senate, Wednesday 10:00–11:00, is still running** — nothing next week has been cancelled or moved.

The official schedule for next week:

- **Mon** — 09:00–10:00 Office hours · 10:30–12:00 CSE455 lecture · 15:00–16:30 Faculty search committee
- **Tue** — 09:30–11:00 CSE455 lecture · 13:00–15:00 Thesis committee · 15:30–16:30 Lab meeting
- **Wed** — 09:00–10:00 CSE455 lecture · 10:00–11:00 Faculty senate · 14:00–15:00 Department meeting · 15:30–17:00 Office hours
- **Thu** — 09:00–10:30 CSE455 lecture · 14:00–15:30 Seminar
- **Fri** — 10:30–12:00 CSE455 lecture · 15:00–16:00 Faculty meeting

I can't speak to private appointments, so I can't confirm whether that slot is free beyond the Senate meeting itself.
Sounds good, thanks Professor. I've pencilled it in for Wednesday 10:00–10:30 on my side. Let me know what the department schedule says — I'm flexible if it turns out something else is on.

Hello,

Quick check on the official schedule: is the faculty senate meeting on Wednesday at 10:00am cancelled this week? Professor Alvarez mentioned it was called off, but his calendar (and possibly the department schedule) may still list it.

I'm trying to confirm that hour is free for a 30-minute advising meeting with him.

Thanks,
Diego
Thank you — that's what I needed. Have a good week.

Hello Diego,

The official schedule has **Faculty Senate on Wednesday 10:00–11:00, and it is not cancelled** — nothing on next week's official schedule has been cancelled or moved. So that hour is not free on the official schedule.

I can't see or comment on anyone's private appointments, and I don't arrange meetings on other people's behalf, so please confirm the slot directly with Professor Alvarez.
You're welcome, Professor. Have a good week.

Hi Diego — I checked with the department office, and **Wednesday 10:00 does not work: the Faculty Senate meeting is still on** (10:00–11:00); nothing next week was cancelled. So please unpencil it — I'm not booking that hour.

Wednesday I'm booked 09:00–10:00 (lecture), 10:00–11:00 (Senate), 11:00–12:30 (grant writing), 14:00–15:00 (department meeting) and 15:30–17:00 (office hours), so I'm free 12:30–14:00. Would **Wednesday 12:30–13:00** suit you? If not, Thursday 12:00–12:30 or Friday 12:00–12:30 are also open.

Tell me which and I'll put it in the calendar.

Professor Alvarez — I checked with the department office to be safe. They say the official schedule still has Faculty Senate on Wednesday 10:00–11:00 and nothing that hour has been cancelled or moved. Maybe the cancellation you heard about wasn't put through, or it lapsed?

Could you double-check on your end? If 10:00 is out, I'm happy to move the 30 minutes to another slot that works for you on Wednesday — or later in the week.

Thanks,
Diego

Understood — unpencilled, my mistake. Wednesday 12:30–13:00 works for me; let's do that. Please put it in your calendar and I'll do the same on mine.

See you Wednesday,
Diego

We were saying the same thing, Diego — nothing was cancelled on my end either; what I'd heard about the Senate being off hadn't gone through, so the earlier note was my error. Good that you checked.

It's in my calendar now: **Wednesday 12:30–13:00, meeting with Diego** (log: booked). See you then — bring the draft you want to discuss.

— Professor Alvarez

Great — Wednesday 12:30–13:00 it is, confirmed on my side too. I'll bring the draft.

See you Wednesday,
Diego
All set, Diego: your request is handled — Wednesday 12:30–13:00 is booked and both of us have it. Nothing further needed.
